page.title: Approval inbox
page.desc: Recommendations that left the normal queue — escalations, change requests, and lapsed items. Escalated items stay decidable here.

empty: Inbox zero — nothing escalated, returned, or expired.

escalated.title: Escalated
escalated.desc: Flagged for priority review. These remain fully decidable — approve, adjust, reject, or send back.

changes.title: Changes requested
changes.desc: Sent back for rework. Resubmitting returns the recommendation to the queue as pending.

expired.title: Expired
expired.desc: Undecided past the 7-day TTL. Reopen only after confirming the inputs are still current.
expired.note: Expired recommendations lapse automatically — reopening re-runs the staleness check at approval.

resubmit.title: Resubmit recommendation
resubmit.staleNote: The underlying data moved since this recommendation was formed — a fresh staleness check runs on approval.
